_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. To add a paper: copy an existing block, edit it, save. Nothing else needs changing. Fields: id (unique slug), type (journal|working|other), themes (array of theme ids from research.json), year, title, title_zh (optional), authors (omit if solo), venue, venue_zh (optional), volume, pages, url (publisher page), links (array of {label,url}), citations ({scholar,cnki}), note (optional extra line), featured (true = shows on homepage), presented (optional).

shadow-banking.label: Shadow banking
shadow-banking.blurb: A measurement-first research programme: defining what shadow banking is in the Chinese context, sizing it consistently over time, and then tracing how it reshapes monetary policy transmission and financial stability.

monetary-transmission.label: Monetary policy transmission and frameworks
monetary-transmission.blurb: How monetary policy actually propagates when financial structures differ from the textbook case — targeted instruments, balance-sheet based analysis, and what central bank legislation implies for the mandates policymakers can pursue.

inflation-dynamics.label: Inflation dynamics
inflation-dynamics.blurb: The empirical strength of the inflation–output relationship and the microeconomic structure behind divergent producer and consumer price movements.

money-capital-markets.label: Money and capital market development
money-capital-markets.blurb: The nature and evolving physical form of money, and the macro-financial preconditions — low inflation, sustainable public debt — under which deep capital markets emerge.
